messages:
sam: Heads-up — we need to lock scope for the post-launch follow-up on Assistant Guidance. Quick sync: what goes into an immediate patch vs what we push as enhancements?
maya: Do we have a severity breakdown from CS? See ticket thread: https://support.redwood.ai/t/2237 — customers hitting incorrect suggestions on non-ASCII input.
devon: That's the regression I flagged. It affects tokenization path on v1.2; reproduced with three customers. For them it's P0 in their flows.
anita: If it's P0 for customer flows, I'd push a hotfix. UX polish requests can wait for the next 2-week sprint.
sam: Proposed plan: (1) hotfix branch + canary rollout for the tokenization bug, (2) grooming call today 3pm PT to triage enhancements and pick 1-2 quick wins, (3) freeze enhancements for hotfix cut at noon.
maya: +1. I'll create a temporary grooming board and tag owners. Cutoff makes sense.
devon: I'll scope the fix, add a unit test and a small e2e that covers multibyte inputs. ETA: EOD today if nothing blocks. PR will reference support tickets.
anita: I'll own release notes / customer comms if devon can get the PR in. We should prep a short KB for CS.
product-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build queued for hotfix branch -> awaiting tests. (id: cb-1965432)
sam: Action list: devon = fix + PR, maya = grooming board + move issues to 'hotfix', anita = announcement draft + KB, sam = coordinate canary & post-canary rollout. 3pm PT meeting to confirm no other P0s.
maya: Also recommend we deprioritize low-telemetry enhancements until we get metrics from the canary. Saves scope.
devon: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/assistant/pull/812 — includes test + short changelog.
anita: Drafted KB and a short customer note, will post for review in #customer-success.
sam: Great. Reminder: keep the hotfix minimal (fix + tests). Any new feature asks go to backlog refinement.
maya: Moving issues now. pinging CS leads for any other urgent reports.
devon: Running canary smoke locally now, will push build to CI in 20m.
anita: Thanks all — see you at 3pm. :thumbsup:
